div.head: Items Scheduled to be Removed
div.p: This appendix provides a partial list of items (elements, attributes, attribute values, datatypes etc.) which are deprecated in this revision of the TEI Guidelines (revision of TEI P5 ).

list.item: Members of model.oddDecl are currently permitted in many places. After 2026-09-03 this feature (which some would call a bug) will be altered so that most such elements will need to occur within a specGrp or schemaSpec (or egXML) element. The affected elements are: classSpec, constraintSpec, dataSpec, elementSpec, macroSpec, outputRendition, and specGrpRef.
